run_make_test_output: run the script with a test output directory argument to generate JUnit XML for Jenkins
readtests_parse_joblog: readtests parses a parallel joblog file and per-test stdout/stderr logs into a sorted list of test dicts
genxml_create_junit_xml: genxml takes a list of test dicts and generates JUnit-compatible XML using yattag
review_readtests_function: review the readtests function to understand how it parses joblog tab-separated values and reads test logs
refactor_genxml_for_custom_suites: refactor the genxml function to support custom testsuite names instead of the hardcoded Protobuf Tests
